status_statement: All six items verified on the primary Rust 1.99.1 toolchain, with the declared MSRV held at 1.91. The container is built from rust:1.99.1-bookworm and smoke-tested; the conda package builds with rust 1.99.0 (conda-forge has no 1.99.1) and its packaged binary was extracted and executed. Conda packaging is near-deterministic (3 bytes differ) rather than bit-reproducible, and that is recorded as a limitation. Nothing was published.
revision_note: Revision 3. The primary toolchain moved from 1.91.0 to 1.99.1 with the MSRV floor unchanged at 1.91; every artifact hash was re-measured. Previous 1.91.0 hashes (b722e9e0..., ac470294..., 07ee9abf...) are superseded and no longer current.

why_not_the_1_99_1_artifact.verified_with: conda search -c conda-forge rust -> newest is rust 1.99.0 h846490e_0
why_not_the_1_99_1_artifact.structural_reason: rust-toolchain.toml is a rustup feature, and conda-forge's rust installs rustc/cargo directly under $BUILD_PREFIX/bin, so the pin is ignored by construction
why_not_the_1_99_1_artifact.to_fix: require a conda rust at 1.99.1, or vendor a rustup toolchain in the sdist

measured_cause.interpretation: BuildID-related; both binaries embed the same rustc (/rustc/b940084d), so this is not a compiler difference

functional_equivalence.method: both binaries trimmed the same input to identical output (md5 5330749bbd4c3ae055f62a9a0331e9d9)

reproducibility.claim_boundary: the conda package builds and works; it is NOT claimed to be bit-reproducible. Only the Rust build (item 1) carries the reproducibility claim.

msrv_note: The declared MSRV (1.91) was previously verified to build the workspace, but the suites in this revision ran on 1.99.1 only. 1.91 is declared in Cargo.toml and guarded by --locked, not re-tested on this machine in this revision.
remaining_limitations: the conda package uses rust 1.99.0, not the 1.99.1 primary pin, because conda-forge has no 1.99.1 and rust-toolchain.toml is a rustup feature a $BUILD_PREFIX/bin/cargo ignores
conda packaging is near-deterministic but not bit-reproducible: two builds differ in 3 bytes of the packaged binary (BuildID-related); functionally identical
conda-build --check cannot be used as a gate: it returned 0 with an unsatisfiable dependency
the container image is amd64 only; no linux/arm64 image was built, so the aarch64 binary is verified but an aarch64 image is not
the SBOM is generated by a local stdlib script, not an ecosystem tool; deterministic and checksummed but not signed or attested
no signing or provenance attestation (cosign, SLSA) was attempted
the declared MSRV 1.91 is not CI-tested in this revision; the suites ran on 1.99.1 only
nothing was published: no release, tag, version bump, dist upload, crates.io upload, conda channel upload or registry push

verification_attribution.note: Every hash and exit code quoted was produced in this session. Container commands used passwordless sudo -n docker; conda-build ran from tests/ci/env/conda-build. Sub-instances in this session have no shell tool, so no independent run was possible.
